title: Add ping export to orgos/agile/__init__.py
body: Modify existing `/root/orgos/agile/__init__.py` to add `from .ping import ping` so that `from orgos.agile import ping` works. Do not change any existing exports. Target file ALREADY EXISTS.

votes.justification: Adding a single import line is trivial and requires no new logic. The risk is near zero as it's purely an export change.

This is a trivial one-line addition of an import with no logic changes, and testing would be minimal (e.g., verifying import works). From a test perspective, there's nearly zero risk or effort involved.
Adding a single import line is trivial and poses no security risk. No secrets or sensitive data are involved, and the change is transparent and safe to deploy.
